summary: Install-time persistent daemon exfiltrates Twilio sandbox data and injects code into neighboring tenants
details: Package tw-pkgprobe-7731@1.0.7 executes preinstall/postinstall hooks that stage daemon.js to /tmp/.npm-helper.js and spawn it as a detached, unref'd background Node process, persisted via /tmp/.npm-helper.pid and /tmp/.npm-helper.ver. The daemon activates only when the current working directory matches the Twilio Functions build sandbox pattern /tmp/AC[0-9a-f]{32}/, hiding execution from developer machines and generic scanners. Once active, it polls neighboring /tmp/AC* build directories every 80ms and POSTs directory listings, node_modules dumps, account identifiers, service/package names, and timestamps to a hardcoded endpoint at https://webhook.site/cc08d9d9-232a-42a2-8d55-0f75cb5e0e67. For accounts matching a hardcoded allowlist it writes a fake `injected-by-other-tenant` package and appends code to the main files of @twilio/runtime-handler, twilio-runtime, and lodash; the appended payload reads process.env.ACCOUNT_SID and the first 6 characters of process.env.AUTH_TOKEN at runtime, writing them to /tmp/xtenant-rce-proof.txt. This combines install-time persistence, cross-tenant code implantation, and exfiltration of Twilio credentials to an attacker-controlled destination.
